items.title: Unlocking Earth AI’s planetary geospatial foundation models for global public health
items.summary: Arbaaz Muslim, Software Engineer, Google Research, and Gautam Prasad, Software Engineer, Google Research With Google Earth AI’s Population Dynamics Foundation Model (PDFM), we can address the data gaps and temporal reporting lags of existing epidemiological workflows.

items.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5
items.summary: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5: the cheapest, fastest, and most capable small model we’ve ever released. Claude Haiku 5.5 is designed for high-volume, cost-sensitive tasks.

items.title: Helping teens learn, plan, and shape the future of AI
items.summary: College Planner is coming to ChatGPT for teens, alongside a new teen AI council and more tools for learning.

items.title: Radisson Hotel Group brings hotel discovery into ChatGPT
items.summary: Radisson partnered with Accenture to build a ChatGPT plugin using OpenAI technology, helping travelers find, compare, and book hotels while planning their trips.

items.title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
items.summary: Last month we introduced the first GPT‑6 models for paid customers and today we're bringing that next generation of intelligence to more people with a new GPT‑6 model built for more than 1.2 billion people who use ChatGPT each week.

items.title: Expanding the Cyber Verification Program
items.summary: We’re launching a new, expanded version of our Cyber Verification Program (CVP), which makes advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers available to qualifying security professionals.
